snippet.title: Tamagorudo - Floor 0 - Teaser
snippet.description:
Which came first — the chicken, the egg, or something else?

TAMAGORUDO - Floor 0  is an atmospheric psychological horror game. Explore a liminal and spooky environment in First-Person, as you just clipped into the Backroom, but there is something wrong with this floor and you will discover that soon.

Add to your Wishlist now : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3673050/TAMAGORUDO__FLOOR_O
